status: provisional generic right-side forms; not base-specific composition

reference.finding: Usually right-side attachment; forms correspond to cursive U+4E87 and U+21FE8. Historical positions and merged shapes vary by base.

outline_source.adaptation: Uniformly scaled native outlines; positive advance for right-side spacing combining marks.

comparison.licence: Original Arphic Public License, embedded name table; not OFL. Reference only, no outlines copied or shipped.
comparison.observed_shaping: HarfBuzz: 假+CA and 外+NHAY become one glyph; 日+either mark and 量+CA remain base plus a 512-unit spacing mark at 1024 units/em. Standalone marks also advance 512.

limitations: No base-specific ligatures or historical top/bottom placements.
Spacing side form must remain explicitly provisional; cmap coverage does not complete linguistic validation.
Cross-browser and fluent-reader review remain open.
browser_strategy: Drawing-only span split in js/vietnamese-marks.js: browser fallback across font shards otherwise emits tofu for a combined base/mark cluster. Logical Unicode graphemes, wrapping and input remain unchanged. Both measurement and paint use the same isolated spacing-mark runs.
